newUserProcess.fifthDescription: Every position has a liquidation price. If the market price reaches it, your position will be closed. Using high leverage increases the risk of liquidation.

Eligible collateral assets such as HYPE and BTC can be used directly as collateral for perp positions without converting to the settlement asset. Collateral assets earn or pay interest depending on whether they are at rest or actively borrowed to open positions.
